name: PROTOCOL AI CITY TACTICS
scope: Both readable SQF files fully reviewed. Binary config/startup binding, dependency declaration and licence unverified. No source copied into product.

contributions.intent: A covering soldier supports others moving behind building cover.
contributions.source: First alive unit moves2.5m from building centre, crouches/watches/suppresses; remaining soldiers move to random offsets4m behind centre after2s.
contributions.cbe: CortexFindCover/CortexSelectAvenue screen routes and cover; CortexFlankStep finite mover/cover roles and actual arrival drive stages. Persistent pairs and capacity balance compose with those roles.
contributions.departure: No building-centre offset as proof of cover or access, no fixed delay as evidence of arrival, no automatic leader-as-cover assignment.

contributions.source: Carrier forceWeaponFire after playAction. CoverSmoke true assignment is commented out; its false reset can leave repeated throws until inventory empty.
contributions.cbe: CROSS_NEAR arrival dispatches carried smoke through CortexThrowGrenade; DangerSmokeStep retains independent danger generation/cooldown and native contact direction. Queued release has original1.5s window and alignment/inventory/authority checks.
contributions.departure: No grenade creation, no waiting for smoke as movement completion and no renewal by repeated retry. Safety fix now yields to queued treatment/dormancy.

contributions.intent: Continue from one covered position to the next.
contributions.source: After another1s, all actors including original coverman receive another building-centre move.
contributions.cbe: Finite planned routes/points, physical progress and role alternation retain the original operation deadline and native-order receipts.
contributions.departure: No overlapping arbitrary target-centre movements. Detailed building/obstacle cover quality still requires runtime evidence.

ownershipAndCostDefects: Loop has no outer delay when there is no eligible contact/building; scans allGroups and peractor findNearestEnemy, repeated nearby building queries.
Uses live hostile transform; forcibly sets RED/COMBAT and enableAttack true over mission intent.
No actor/locality/medical/native-task/Zeus/new-operation lifecycle; local leader check alone does not grant authority over every actor.
configuration: Two CBA toggles are behaviour intent references, not a reason to add duplicate source-branded switches or Zeus settings modules.
concreteFix: CortexThrowGrenade admission, prequeue commitment and delayed aim/release now reject hidden, simulation-disabled and queued-treatment actors. DangerSmokeStep filters same before inventory work. No treatment mutation, grenade spending on refusal, timer renewal or wait worker.
remaining: Physical cover/route quality, actual smoke deployment/effect, casualty/owner handover and performance remain unverified. No broad parity claim.
